::: {.callout-tip title="TL;DR" icon="false"}
LeCun's thesis: autoregressive token prediction is a dead end for reasoning.
**JEPA** (I-JEPA 2023, V-JEPA 2024) predicts in *abstract latent space* rather
than pixel/token space, and **energy-based models** + **world models** aim to
let agents plan by simulating futures instead of memorizing sequences.
:::

**Depends on:** [Self-Supervised & Contrastive Learning](../supp/self_supervised.qmd)
